property_summary: For any caller and any deposited amount, withdrawAll always reverts the whole transaction if the external low-level call to send Ether fails (i.e., withdrawAll either successfully sends funds and clears credit, or reverts); the mutant that omits require can complete without reverting even when the external call fails, violating this guarantee.
change_summary: Change the require to not revert on call failure by omitting require, allowing function to complete even if transfer failed.
